intent: To demonstrate that eyewitness misinterpretation is the leading cause of wrongful convictions.

requirements.question: Must the video state the exact top value 72%, or is 'leading cause' alone sufficient?
Is it enough to compare eyewitness to all other causes, or must the runner-up gap also be explicit?

units.claim: Eyewitness misinterpretation is the leading/highest cause in the chart, with value 72 (relative_value 0.72, i.e. 72%).
accept: Eyewitness misinterpretation is the leading cause at 72%.
72% of the cited exonerations involve inaccurate eyewitness testimony.
The eyewitness bar is highest, at about 72%.
units.evidence: The eyewitness-misinterpretation bar must be visibly the tallest and must be labeled or annotated with 72% or 72.

units.claim: Eyewitness misinterpretation is greater than every other listed cause: 72 vs improper forensics 47, false confessions 27, and informant 15.
accept: Eyewitness misinterpretation tops all other listed causes.
No other listed cause reaches the eyewitness misinterpretation level.
units.evidence: The eyewitness bar must be shown alongside the other three bars at lower heights, with values or labels visible enough to compare.

optional_valid: Improper forensics is the runner-up at 47%.
False confessions is 27% and informant is 15%.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded
